storage_controller.cacheSwapReasoning: MR416i-p (-p series) on Gen11 is only available with 8GB flash-backed cache. The 4GB cache variant does not exist for PCIe standup controllers in the MR4x family on Gen11. If the customer requested 4GB cache with an OCP controller, pivoting to PCIe inherently upgrades to 8GB at no additional cache cost — this is a hardware platform constraint, not a discretionary upsell.
